verdict.rationale: Synctera is a banking-as-a-service platform that processes sensitive customer data, so whether it lets customers prevent their data from being used for AI training is a fair privacy-posture question. The evidence pack covers customers, accounts, cards, payments, KYC, webhooks and docs/llms.txt availability. None of it addresses AI training data use, opt-outs or a data-use policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
